 Implement a General Rate Increase for Electric     )
 Service                                            )

       ORDER DIRECTING THE FILING OF EXEMPLAR TARIFF SHEETS

Issue Date: November 16, 2026                           Effective Date: November 16, 2026

       Evergy Metro, Inc. d/b/a Evergy Missouri Metro (Evergy Metro) and Google LLC

(Google) filed a partial stipulation and agreement addressing how Large Load Power Service

(LLPS) customers would be included in the Fuel Adjustment Clause (FAC). Evergy Metro and

Google agreed that the FAC’s operation would not be modified because of LLPS customers.

However, the stipulation and agreement includes some proposed changes to various FAC

provisions.

       So, the Commission may better understand the impact of the proposed changes to

the FAC, the Commission will direct Evergy Metro to file exemplar FAC tariff sheets

demonstrating how its proposed FAC will work by November 23, 2026. The Commission will

set a deadline for other comments about Evergy Metro’s exemplar FAC tariff sheets.

       THE COMMISSION ORDERS THAT:

       1.     Evergy Metro must file exemplar FAC tariff sheets as discussed in the body of

this order no later than November 23, 2026.

       2.     Any other responses to Evergy Metro’s exemplar FAC tariff sheets must be

filed no later than November 30, 2026.
       3.     This order is effective when issued.

                                         BY THE COMMISSION




                                         Nancy Dippell
                                         Secretary
